title: Answer a technical interview with evidence
summary: Explain a decision, your contribution and a measured result.
learningObjectives: Give a structured technical interview answer without memorizing a script.

sections.title: Your mission
sections.body: An interviewer asks about a production decision you personally influenced.

sections.title: Candidate notes
sections.content: Situation: API latency reached 1.8 seconds during campaigns. Task: reduce p95 below 700 ms before the next launch. Action: I profiled queries, found an N+1 path, proposed batching, added load tests and coordinated rollout with SRE. Result: p95 fell to 520 ms and database load fell 28%. Reflection: I would add query-count alerts earlier.

exercises.question: Which phrase best proves personal contribution?
options: I profiled the queries, proposed batching and added load tests.
correctAnswer: I profiled the queries, proposed batching and added load tests.
exercises.explanation: It names decisions and actions owned by the candidate.

performanceTask.title: Tell the decision story
performanceTask.scenario: Answer: Tell me about a technical decision you made under a deadline.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Answer in English from the notes without opening the model response.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak for up to two minutes. Cover context, your decision/action, measured result and one reflection.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Before a major campaign, our API p95 latency reached 1.8 seconds and I was responsible for getting it below 700 milliseconds. I profiled the request and found an N+1 query path. I proposed batching, added load tests and worked with SRE on a gradual rollout. The change reduced p95 to 520 milliseconds and database load by 28 percent. Looking back, I would add query-count alerts earlier so we detect this regression before peak traffic.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Answer again using I for your decisions, one measured result and a brief reflection instead of extra background.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Describe a time you reduced deployment failures under a deadline. Include your action, collaboration, measured result and lesson.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Answer a new technical-decision question with context, ownership, evidence and reflection.

rubric.label: Complete story
rubric.description: Connects context, action, result and reflection.

rubric.label: Personal ownership
rubric.description: Distinguishes personal decisions from team activity.

rubric.label: Measured evidence
rubric.description: Uses a concrete result and explains why it mattered.
